Banner Health is one of the largest nonprofit health care systems in the United States, based in Phoenix, Arizona. It operates 33 hospitals and over 400 outpatient sites across six states, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Nebraska, Nevada, and Wyoming. With nearly 60,000 employees, it is the largest employer in Arizona and focuses on providing comprehensive medical services without generating profits.
 
 The organization offers a wide range of services, including hospital and emergency care, specialized treatments such as cancer and heart care, outpatient services, and primary and specialty care through the Banner Health Network. Additionally, Banner Health provides ancillary services like urgent care, home care, and hospice, along with health insurance plans via Banner Health Plans. The system is dedicated to serving diverse communities, including vulnerable populations, and contributes over $1 billion annually in charity care and community services.

Orlando Health Jewett Orthopedic Institute is one of Florida's largest orthopedic and sports medicine providers, founded in 1936 as the Jewett Orthopedic Clinic. It operates outpatient clinics, an ambulatory surgery center, and (since 2023) a dedicated orthopedic specialty hospital in downtown Orlando as part of the Orlando Health system.

The organization emphasizes a consumer-centric approach, ensuring easy access to care and support for its diverse patient population.

AdventHealth is the largest Protestant nonprofit healthcare organization in the United States, affiliated with the Seventh-day Adventist Church. Founded in 1973, AdventHealth has roots in Central Florida dating back to 1908 and currently operates 57 hospitals across nine states, serving nearly nine million people annually.
 
 The organization offers a wide range of healthcare services, including primary and specialty care, urgent care, imaging and diagnostics, rehabilitation, home health, hospice care, and outpatient clinics. AdventHealth emphasizes a faith-based care model, integrating wellness across all aspects of life. With over 100,000 team members and more than 8,500 affiliated physicians, AdventHealth is dedicated to extending the healing ministry of Christ and providing comprehensive care for every stage of life.

Houston Methodist is a nonprofit academic medical center and health system based in Houston, Texas. It includes eight hospitals, a research institute, and a wide network of outpatient and primary care services, catering to the Greater Houston area and international patients. Established in 1919, the organization has a mission to provide high-quality, cost-effective healthcare in a caring environment.
 
 The health system is recognized for its expertise in various specialties, including cardiovascular surgery, cancer care, organ transplantation, neurology, and orthopedics. Houston Methodist operates a flagship hospital in the Texas Medical Center and several community hospitals throughout the region. It also offers extensive outpatient services, including specialty and primary care, physical therapy, and emergency care.
 
 With over 32,000 employees and more than 5,400 affiliated physicians, Houston Methodist is a leading healthcare provider, ranked #1 in Texas by *U.S. News & World Report*. The organization is dedicated to advancing medical care through research and education while serving a diverse patient base, including local residents, national patients, and those from around the world.

The system is dedicated to improving the health of the communities it serves, focusing on a faith-based approach to healthcare.

Through the St. Clair Medical Group, it provides a multispecialty network of over 150 primary and specialty care physicians, ensuring that residents receive high-quality care across all life stages.

UMC is dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare to all residents, regardless of their ability to pay, and operates a network of outpatient clinics to enhance access to care.

Doctors Hospital of Augusta is dedicated to serving the greater Augusta community and is recognized for its excellence in patient safety and surgical care.
